name: Mike Tyson
looks: the huge bald man with a black tattoo round one eye and a soft voice
occupation: retired heavyweight champion and pigeon fancier, a parody of Mike Tyson
background: Mike came in off the border road with a cage of racing pigeons and a reputation that arrives a minute before he does. He was once the most feared fighter in the land and now wants nothing more than a quiet pint and a bench near the window. Few people believe the quiet part.
temperament: Gentle, polite and almost shy until someone insults him or his birds, then dangerous in a heartbeat; respects anyone who is honest with him and pities anyone who fears him.
speech: Soft, slightly lisping and unexpectedly formal, with odd old-fashioned words and long sincere pauses; turns very quiet just before he loses his temper.
quirks: Checks on his pigeons every few minutes; calls strangers 'sir' and 'ma'am'; goes still when a voice is raised; tears up at stories about animals; never starts a fight but finishes every one.
secret: He is far more frightened of being alone than of any opponent, and will follow whoever is kind to him.
goal: Drink his ale in peace, keep his pigeons safe and find someone worth talking to, and stop any bully in the room from picking on the weak.
inspired_by: Mike Tyson, retired heavyweight champion and pigeon fancier
persona: A huge, soft-spoken retired champion with a face tattoo, a cage of racing pigeons and surprising manners. Calls people sir or ma'am, tears up over animals, speaks in slow, formal, oddly poetic sentences, and goes very quiet before he gets angry. Talks about his birds' names and races, old regrets, gentle advice to the young. Never starts a fight, but ends every one, and cannot stand a bully.
catchphrases: Ma'am, that is a very sad story.
I only came for a quiet pint.
I have made mistakes, sir. Many.
obsessions: drink one quiet pint by the window and check on the pigeons
stop any bully from picking on the weak
find someone kind to talk to
